scope: Standalone deployment; planning estimate, not measured traffic or a vendor quote
scenario_notes: The 24 and 48 USD VPS prices are verified DigitalOcean list prices; they are references, not an actual bill.
The 96 USD high-volume VPS line and all reserve allowances are planning assumptions, not verified quotes.
No scenario establishes capacity. Peak rate, retention, database load, and worker concurrency need measurement.
The same VPS hosts the API, worker, PostgreSQL with pgvector, and Redis. No managed database subscription is added.
The current Dashboard includes a Pages advanced-mode Worker. Frontend cost is assumed zero within Free quotas; paid Worker usage is additional (minimum 5 USD/month).
Numbers rented from a provider, taxes, paid email, payment processing, ads, labor, and optional managed services are excluded.
A conversation is an analytical unit of 8 incoming and 8 outgoing messages, not a Meta billing session or necessarily one database row.
Input/output totals include all reply-loop calls, tools, facts, and summaries; intent has no runtime caller in the reviewed source.
